job.title: Solution Architect (all genders) SAP Commerce Cloud

tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer & Techno-Functional Consultant
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, microservices, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record designing headless commerce architectures, optimizing data pipelines, and guiding international stakeholders through requirements, design and production support. Strong Agile, CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes, and AI-assisted development experience with a focus on scalability and continuous improvement.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Solution Architect (all genders) SAP Commerce Cloud
cover_en.hook: I am excited by valantic’s reputation for delivering cutting-edge SAP solutions that drive digital transformation. With over five years of end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am eager to shape enterprise-wide commerce architectures for your clients.

bullets.label: Architectural Design
bullets.text: Designed and implemented scalable SAP Commerce Cloud back-end and front-end components, applying Java, Spring and microservices patterns to meet complex business requirements.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and OCC REST services, ensuring seamless integration with ERP, MDM and third-party systems across global teams.

bullets.label: Leadership & Mentoring
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance, performed code reviews and mentored junior developers while translating stakeholder requirements into functional specifications.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Delivered features in Scrum sprints, managed CI/CD pipelines on CCv2, and leveraged Docker/Kubernetes for reliable cloud deployments.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026, earliest start 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site arrangements.

tailoring.why_company: valantic stands out as a leading digital transformation partner that combines deep SAP expertise with innovative consulting approaches. Its commitment to sustainable, customer-centric solutions and its strong presence in the German market align perfectly with my passion for building scalable SAP Commerce Cloud architectures that deliver measurable business value. I want to contribute to valantic’s mission of shaping the future of commerce for its diverse clientele.
tailoring.motivation_short: Join valantic to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise in a forward-thinking environment that values innovation, sustainability and impactful digital solutions.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m keen to discuss how I can help valantic deliver next-gen commerce solutions. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Solution Architect SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Solution Architect (SAP Commerce Cloud) role at valantic. I bring over five years of hands-on experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for global enterprises, strong integration expertise, and a proven record of architectural design. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.
